arguments.description: A single imposing imperial mountain-fortress main castle as a detailed fantasy game pixel-art building sprite. Four substantial unequal grey-stone corner towers, tall central keep, stepped battlements, narrow arched windows, dark-blue slate roofs at several heights, iron braces, two restrained red-and-gold banners, deep arched front entrance. Weathered individual masonry blocks; convincing heavy castle mass, angular silhouette, no generic square tower. Small integrated rocky foundation only; the enormous mountain, roads, walls and barracks will be separate assets. Shallow three-quarter view with roof and front visible, warm upper-left light, crisp dark selective outline, deliberate readable pixel clusters, controlled muted palette. One isolated building on transparent background, no scenery or cast shadow, clear border and front-foot ground anchor.
